sdk_headers.name: VC98 INCLUDE tree, Visual Studio 6.0 Enterprise CD1 (VC98/INCLUDE plus the six installer long names)
sdk_headers.note: Pinned 2026-11-09 (Scout1201) for the RA2_SDK_HEADERS migration switch (docs/DECISIONS.md). Hypothesis: the original was compiled against the VC6 CD1 system headers. Unverified: a later Platform SDK, a DirectX SDK newer than VC98's DX5-level DDRAW.H/DSOUND.H/DINPUT.H, Bink headers (bink.h/rad.h, not on the media), Westwood Online API headers (not on the media), and an SP3 header overlay (SP3 media not on hand). Changing this set is a whole-tree change. The files stay private (local default_directory, or config sdk_include_directory); only their hashes are tracked.
